name: linksetgo
description: Open-source deep-link infrastructure for mobile apps, QR routing, safe fallbacks, workspaces, and custom domains.

scripts.build: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --max-old-space-size=8000" next build && node scripts/sanitize-standalone.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:int && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:marketing && npm run test:e2e:cloud-signup
scripts.test:e2e: cross-env E2E_SUITE=community E2E_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3100 RELAY_EDITION=community NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --import=tsx/esm" playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:marketing: cross-env E2E_SUITE=marketing E2E_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3100 RELAY_EDITION=cloud CLOUD_APP_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3100 MARKETING_SITE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3100 PUBLIC_LINK_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3100 NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3100 NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3100 NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --import=tsx/esm" playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:cloud-signup: cross-env E2E_SUITE=cloud-signup E2E_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3100 RELAY_EDITION=cloud CLOUD_SIGNUP_ENABLED=true CLOUD_APP_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3100 SHARED_LINK_BASE_URL=http://[::1]:3200 TRUST_PROXY_CLIENT_IP_HEADER=true CLOUD_VERIFICATION_WEBHOOK_URL=https://mailer.linksetgo.test/email CLOUD_VERIFICATION_WEBHOOK_SECRET=e2e-webhook-secret-not-for-production-123456 MARKETING_SITE_URL=http://localhost:3100 PUBLIC_LINK_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3100 NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3100 NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=http://localhost:3100 NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --import=tsx/esm" playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run check:architecture && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:int && npm run build
